summary: Backend regression suite passed all 4 API tests; marketplace UI, search, cart removal, checkout auth gating, and mobile overflow were exercised. Google demo login fails at the API boundary.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking Continue with Google sends {email,name} without required password; /api/auth/google returns HTTP 422 and Emergent displays an unhandled rejection overlay.

action_items: Fix the Google demo request contract: make password optional for /api/auth/google or send a valid demo password from the frontend; handle the request error in the modal instead of allowing an unhandled rejection overlay.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthInput requires password for the Google endpoint even though google_demo does not use it; this contract mismatch causes the advertised Google flow to fail.
seed_data_creation: Created two temporary TEST seller/buyer accounts and one TEST pending rental through public APIs; no seeded records modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Catalog/search/cart/mobile and admin seller approval pass. Retest Google demo login after request schema fix, then email register/login and authenticated checkout UI.
rca of the issue: AuthInput.password is mandatory (line 22 server.py), while frontend Auth.google posts only email and name (App.js). FastAPI validation rejects the request before google_demo executes, producing 422 and an uncaught Axios rejection. Google sign-in is MOCKED per requirements.
